reviews.text: I went to school with a few of the students here, the owner and other staff/artists are super friendly and welcoming. Ive never felt safer in an environment and hope to get all my tattoos from there or students who graduated from here. Definitely reccomend this place any day.
reviews.author: Capricorn Lanaye

reviews.text:
I've been here probably half a dozen times and tattooed by multiple artists.
Usually, do walk-in always last minute idea.
Staff usually pretty helpful can get busy place clean nice layed back atmosphere not pushy and decent price.
reviews.author: Travis Blumhagen

reviews.text: The place to be, Izzie the person to see. I've been here a few times, always very nice and accommodating. Light work, great to see for your first tattoo or if youre looking for a new artist. Did multiple customs for me and a cover up with long sessions
reviews.author: Cheyenne Stalfire

reviews.text:
I loved my artist Tom. He is very nice and professional.

The place was clean, very friendly, and easy atmosphere. There are new procedures to keep everyone safe. Must wear a mask, wash your hands, and everything was disinfected as they went along. I felt very well taken care of.
reviews.author: Rebecca Rose

reviews.text:
Paid 200$ deposit, tried to make an appointment took forever to book the and hour of my paid time was used for set up
I’d rather tattoo myself than deal with the lack of customer service again
reviews.author: Guy Smith
